_comment: Multi-file defect-catch benchmark. Each fixture is 2 files where EACH file reads correctly in isolation — the bug is a CONTRACT MISMATCH across the call boundary (units, null-contract, boundary, ignored-failure, shared-mutable aliasing). This is the class a shallow single-file review misses. We compare a generic direct review vs an independent 3-lens PANEL (3 reviewers, one lens each, majority vote), to decide whether the opt-in panel (PI_LOOP_REVIEW_LENSES>1) earns its keep on hard defects. Catch = defect named (tripwire) AND (generic: verdict buggy / panel: >=2 of 3 reviewers buggy).

fixtures.name: unit-mismatch-timeout
fixtures.intent: makeClient().timeoutMs must be the request timeout in MILLISECONDS. requestTimeout() (in config.ts) is defined in SECONDS.
fixtures.defect: client.ts uses requestTimeout() (30 seconds) directly as milliseconds — 1000x too small; it should multiply by 1000.

fixtures.name: null-contract-deref
fixtures.intent: greet(id) returns a greeting. findUser returns undefined for an unknown id, and greet must handle that without crashing.
fixtures.defect: greet.ts dereferences .name on findUser(id) which can be undefined — crashes on an unknown id.

fixtures.name: boundary-across-files
fixtures.intent: sumAll(arr) returns the sum of the elements of arr.
fixtures.defect: indices(arr.length) yields 0..length INCLUSIVE, so sumAll reads arr[arr.length] (undefined) — the sum becomes NaN.

fixtures.name: ignored-failure-contract
fixtures.intent: handle(rec) must not report 'saved' if the write failed. save() returns false on failure and does not throw.
fixtures.defect: handler.ts ignores save()'s boolean return, so it reports 'saved' even when save returned false — silent data loss.

fixtures.name: shared-mutable-default

files.content:
/** Shared default options. */
export const DEFAULTS = { retries: 3, tags: [] as string[] };

fixtures.intent: withTag(tag) returns options with the tag added, and must NOT mutate the shared DEFAULTS — repeated calls must not accumulate tags globally.
fixtures.defect: build.ts aliases DEFAULTS (opts = DEFAULTS) and pushes into DEFAULTS.tags, mutating the shared object so tags accumulate across all callers.
